periods.description: Rare one-of-a-kind Drag-Rides with power far above general-purpose machines and unique Divine Raiment abilities.
periods.principles: Each Divine Drag-Ride possesses a unique special power and superior performance, but its operation severely drains the pilot and risks instability or loss of control.
periods.classification: Named unique machines such as Tiamat, Bahamut, Fafnir, and Typhon.
periods.origin: Excavated from ancient ruins and restricted by state law due to rarity and danger.
limitations: overuse can cause collapse or machine instability
